content.short: Smart Collective is a private discord community.
content.description:
Our mission is help our members set and achieve SMART goals. Our community is private and you need to submit an application to join as well as hold our token.

By uniting our community through a social token members can be certain that everyone in the group has a personal stake in the DAO and hence a vested interest in its success. We welcome people from many different backgrounds because diversity is essential for our community to thrive. Having an inclusive and diverse environment allows broader viewpoints to be integrated when brainstorming, problem solving and developing new ideas.

One of our primary goals is to build a community with strong bonds and create a welcoming and cheerful environment.
